programme.desc: Morticia's concern that Lurch is overworked leads Gomez to the operating table to assemble a custom-built secondary butler. Lurch lets the robot do all the work and then begins to feel that he isn't needed anymore.

programme.title: Conmen Case Files: Emma Golightly – Lonely Hearts Con Woman
programme.desc: Golightly conned tens of thousands of dollars from men she found in lonely hearts columns and dating sites.
programme.sub-title: Emma Golightly – Lonely Hearts Con Woman

programme.title: Conmen Case Files
programme.desc: Fake celebrity clairvoyant Williams preyed on the elderly by performing fake readings, including one where he directed his client to a forged will.

programme.title: Conmen Case Files: Robert Hyams – The Suspect Scientist
programme.desc: Hyams posed as a leading scientist and millionaire art buyer before fleeing to California where he posed as a leading academic.

programme.title: Conmen Case Files: Mark Hatton – aka Alex de Rothschild – The Bogus Banker
programme.desc: Posing as a member of the Rothschild banking dynasty, he duped a string of women in the UK and US.
programme.sub-title: Mark Hatton – aka Alex de Rothschild – The Bogus Banker

programme.title: 72 Hours: Lone Wolf
programme.desc: Two murders of mothers in their own homes send shock-waves through a normally quiet and friendly town where everybody leaves their doors unlocked. The crimes go unsolved until twenty-eight years later.

programme.title: 72 Hours: The Game
programme.desc: 1995 - Houston, Texas. A lonely man calls a dating service and gets more than he bargained for when he is met at gunpoint and robbed by his “dates”. The women, dubbed “Thelma & Louise”, lure men with the promise of sex but then drug and rob them.

programme.title: 72 Hours: Monster of Miramichi
programme.desc: Firemen are called to a blaze and discover two sisters, one dead and the other on death's door. Detectives learn that a man snuck in and brutally sexually assaulted the sisters before setting fire to the house.

programme.title: Gods of Egypt
programme.desc: A defiant mortal (Brenton Thwaites) forms an unlikely alliance with the powerful god Horus (Nikolaj Coster-Waldau) to save the world from Set (Gerard Butler), the merciless god of darkness.

programme.title: The Fall
programme.desc: A bedridden patient (Lee Pace) captivates a hospitalized girl (Catinca Untaru) with a fantastic tale involving heroes, mystics and villains on a desert island.

programme.title: The Legend of Hercules
programme.desc: Betrayed by his stepfather, the King, and exiled and sold into slavery because of a forbidden love, Hercules must use his formidable powers to fight his way back to his rightful kingdom.

programme.title: The Legend of Hercules
programme.desc: Betrayed by his stepfather, the King, and exiled and sold into slavery because of a forbidden love, Hercules must use his formidable powers to fight his way back to his rightful kingdom.

programme.title: Conan the Barbarian
programme.desc: The Cimmerian warrior slashes his way across Hyboria on a mission that begins as a personal vendetta but turns into an epic battle against a supernatural evil.

programme.title: Season of the Witch
programme.desc: Knights (Nicolas Cage, Ron Perlman) escort an accused witch to a remote abbey, where monks will perform a ritual in the hope of ending the pestilence ravaging Europe.

programme.title: Wild Card
programme.desc: When a Las Vegas bodyguard with lethal skills and a gambling problem gets in trouble with the mob, he has one last play and it's all or nothing.

programme.title: Safe
programme.desc: A young girl whose memory holds a priceless numerical code, finds herself pursued. Coming to her aid is an ex-cage fighter whose life was destroyed by the gangsters on Mei's trail.

programme.title: Revolver
programme.desc: Hotshot gambler Jake Green spends seven years in jail after taking the rap for crime boss Dorothy Macha. When he is released, Jake partners with brothers Avi and Zach to take Macha down.

programme.title: South Park starts at 9pm
programme.desc: CHANNEL STARTS AT 9PM Follow everyone's favorite troublemakers—Stan, Kyle, Cartman, and Kenny--from the very beginning of their unforgettable adventures.

programme.title: South Park: Hotter than Summer: Over Logging
programme.desc: Over Logging: Panic reigns as South Park finds that the internet's gone! The Marshes decide to go hunting for the internet in California and end up in an "internet refugee camp". (S12, E06)

programme.title: South Park: Super Fun Time
programme.desc: Super Fun Time: The kids go on a field trip to a 'living museum'. A hostage situation ensues when robbers use the place to evade police. It's up to Cartman and Butters to save the day! (S12, E07)

programme.title: South Park: The China Probrem
programme.desc: The China Probrem: Alarmed by the grandeur of the Olympic ceremonies, Cartman enlists Butters to help him confront the Chinese. (S12, E08)

programme.title: South Park: Breast Cancer Show Ever
programme.desc: Breast Cancer Show Ever: Cartman's reputation is at stake when he is too afraid to fight Wendy, who is furious about his breast cancer jibes. Cartman then takes things from bad to worse! (S12, E09)

programme.title: South Park: Pandemic (Part 1)
programme.desc: Pandemic (1): South Park goes all 'Cloverfield' when large, mysterious creatures begin causing havoc around the globe, all caught on Randy's shaky cam. The boys start a Peruvian flute band. (S12, E10)

programme.title: South Park: Pandemic 2: The Startling (Part 2)
programme.desc: Pandemic 2 - The Startling (2): Giant guinea pigs are attacking cities around the world. The boys have the key which will save humanity, but they are stuck in the Andes and bored to boot! (S12, E11)

programme.title: South Park: About Last Night...
programme.desc: About Last Night...: While the country celebrates the election of Obama, a band of unlikely super-thieves begin an audacious jewel heist. The town's Republicans fear the apocalypse is nigh. (S12, E12)

programme.title: South Park: Elementary School Musical
programme.desc: Elementary School Musical: When the all-singing and dancing musical craze hits South Park, the boys must embrace it or relinquish their popularity. Will they stick to their guns? (S12, E13)

programme.title: South Park: The Ungroundable
programme.desc: The Ungroundable: Fed up with how he is treated by his parents, the eternally innocent Butters embraces the new vampire craze a little too enthusiastically. Who will he choose to feed on? (S12, E14)

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: The Ring: To the amazement of the boys Kenny has a girlfriend, but they must face the might of Disney and its leader to free Kenny from the powers of his libido-squashing purity ring. (S13, E01)

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: The 'C**n: By day he is Eric Cartman, a fat fourth-grader. By night, he is The C**n, a crime fighting vigilante dressed in a raccoon outfit, desperate for attention. But who is Mysterion? (S13, E02)

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Margaritaville: In a riff on the story of Christ, Randy implores the town to stop angering the economy with rash purchases, but a young Jew, Kyle, challenges this orthodox teaching. (S13, E03)

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Eat, Pray, Queef: When a new Canadian show called The Queef Sisters starts a 'queefing' craze the men of South Park are disgusted by this new female craze and move to get it banned. (S13, E04)

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Fishsticks: Jimmy is angry that Cartman tries to take credit for a joke he created that is now sweeping the nation. But an angry Kanye West just can't get his head around the punch line. (S13, E05)

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Pinewood Derby: Randy and Stan somehow discover warp speed, allowing Earth to join the Galactic Federation of Planets, but will an alien gangster and his 'space cash' ruin everything? (S13, E06)

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Fatbeard: Cartman hears of all the riches being plundered by the pirates in Somalia, so dons his eye patch and leads a motley crew off to Africa to get in on the act. (S13, E07)

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Dead Celebrities: The ghost of Michael Jackson refuses to accept his death, leaving the rest of the recently dead celebrities frustrated in purgatory and poor Ike having ghostly visits! (S13, E08)

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Butter's Bottom B***h: Oblivious to his actions, the little innocent Butters starts up 'The Kissing Company', and is soon the most notorious pimp around. Will undercover cops ruin his fun? (S13, E09)
programme.sub-title: Hotter than Summer: Butters' Bottom Bitch

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: W. T. F.: After seeing their first live WWE wrestling match the boys decide to form their own wrestling federation... and gain a huge redneck following! (S13, E10)

programme.title: La Invasión
programme.desc: Algunos residentes de la ciudad tienen que unirse después de una devastadora invasión alienígena. Mientras luchan por sobrevivir, se dan cuenta de que deben ir un paso por delante de sus atacantes.

programme.title: El Visitante
programme.desc: Un extraño aparece de la nada tras una confusión en una estación de tren. Prot desafía a los científicos y atrae la atención del Dr. Powell, cuyo escepticismo inicial se convierte rápidamente en fascinación y asombro.

programme.title: In Time
programme.desc: En un futuro en que la gente deja de envejecer a los 25 años, el dinero puede comprar la juventud inmortal.

programme.title: The Colony
programme.desc: Bajo la superficie helada, los sobrevivientes de la Colonia 7 luchan mientras los alimentos y las temperaturas bajan. Luego de una expedición descubren una amenaza peor de lo imaginado.

programme.title: Cuenta Regresiva
programme.desc: Un profesor universitario se encuentra con una serie de números encontrados en una cápsula de tiempo, y llega a darse cuenta de que han predicho cada desastre de los últimos 50 años.

programme.title: Ataque de tiburón de dos cabezas
programme.desc: Después de que su bote es hundido por un tiburón mutado de dos cabezas, los sobrevivientes escapan a un atolón desierto. Pero cuando comienza a inundarse, nadie está a salvo de la doble mandíbula del monstruo.

programme.title: Bull Shark
programme.desc: Un tiburón hambriento comienza a alimentarse de los desprevenidos visitantes del lago en un pequeño pueblo de Texas.

programme.title: In Time
programme.desc: En un futuro en que la gente deja de envejecer a los 25 años, el dinero puede comprar la juventud inmortal.

programme.title: El Visitante
programme.desc: Un extraño aparece de la nada tras una confusión en una estación de tren. Prot desafía a los científicos y atrae la atención del Dr. Powell, cuyo escepticismo inicial se convierte rápidamente en fascinación y asombro.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Después de su divorcio, Al se encontró con la necesidad de un nuevo comienzo y hogar. Lo que encontró fue algo para lo que nunca podría haberse preparado.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Después de que una hermosa adolescente atrae la atención de una presencia desconocida, se convierte en el objetivo de sus avances, causando estragos en su vida y en la de su familia.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: El fantasma de un adolescente atormentado rompe la serenidad de una familia joven poco después de mudarse a su primera casa.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Una familia cree que tiene un fantasma inofensivo en su casa hasta que comienza a amenazar a los niños. No queriendo dejar que el mal gane, la familia recurre a la Iglesia Católica para expulsar al demonio.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Una madre y una hija saben que su casa está encantada. Pero mientras la madre cree que es el espíritu de su novio asesinado, su hija cree que es mucho más oscuro.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: El fantasma de un adolescente atormentado rompe la serenidad de una familia joven poco después de mudarse a su primera casa.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Angela, una recién casada, está emocionada de comenzar su nueva vida con Stephen cuando las pesadillas recurrentes que experimentó cuando era niña resurgen repentinamente. Pronto, la vieja y amenazadora bruja de sus sueños invade sus horas de vigilia.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Todo parece ir por buen camino cuando Sidney traslada a su novia embarazada a la casa que comparte con su madre. Pero su felicidad se rompe repentinamente cuando la familia comienza a experimentar eventos perturbadores.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Carl Johnson comienza a usar un tablero espiritual con sus hermanos, Keith y Cynthia, para comunicarse con el espíritu que acecha su hogar.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Cuando el esposo bombero de Jeanette muere en el cumplimiento del deber, ella recurre a su indomable espíritu neoyorquino y traslada a sus hijas a una aldea rústica en Long Island para comenzar de nuevo. Pero su refugio rural resulta todo menos idílico.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Joy, una madre trabajadora de tres hijos, asume que el fin de semana de una niña en una plantación encantada será un cambio de ritmo agradable.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Angelina Balistreri cree que su hogar está perseguido por un fantasma inofensivo, mientras que su esposo, Emiliano, se muestra escéptico ante lo paranormal.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Después de que su madre, Linda, regresa de un viaje rutinario al extranjero a la India, Kara Dravis comienza a experimentar sucesos inexplicables y aterradores en su casa que la llevan a creer que está encantada.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Los sonidos extraños y las sensaciones espeluznantes llevan a Charles Gonzales a sospechar que un espíritu acecha su hogar en Florida.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Jeanette Osborne se regala un juego de máscaras haitianas para decorar la casa de sus sueños en California que comparte con su esposo Bob Griffith y su hijo Grier de 12 años.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Desde que tiene memoria, Markie Beason ha sentido una presencia en su casa. Si bien su familia cree que es solo su imaginación, Markie está más segura de que su casa está encantada a medida que los espíritus centran su atención en ella.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Cuando muere el amado padre de Phil Pritchard, cae en una profunda depresión que lo vuelve vulnerable a un mal sobrenatural que comienza a influir en él y no se detendrá ante nada para convertirlo en un peón en su incansable sed de miseria y asesinato.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Cuando Tracey Berrios experimenta una actividad paranormal dentro de su nuevo hogar, sospecha que hay espíritus vinculados a la historia de la casa.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Tammy Shea, madre soltera de tres hijos, traslada a su familia para comenzar de nuevo, pero su sueño se convierte en una pesadilla cuando su familia se enfrenta a múltiples entidades.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Cuando Deborah Utley comienza a experimentar eventos paranormales en su hogar, recurre a su fe en busca de protección.

programme.title: Viaje A La Luna
programme.desc: Como parte de un truco publicitario de la marca de cigarros arabe bujala, el caballerro del crisantemo es raptado por su publicista y sus lunaticos con el objetivo de que no de a conocer su identidad.

programme.title: Viva Chihuahua
programme.desc: Miguel lopez, es un abogado cuya profesion le ha traido muy buenas referencias con su proxima familia politica y su futura esposa laura, pero con un lado obscuro, miguel tiene una doble personalidad con la que se hace llamar pancho lopez.

programme.title: Viva El Amor
programme.desc: Una joven bella y liberada francesa decide tener un amorio con un hombre casado e ir con el a la habana, pero le exige a su compañero que pida su divorcio. Su esposa le pide a su vez que, para aceptar, debe conocer a su amante; asi que la lleva ante ella.

programme.title: Vuelve El Texano
programme.desc: El texano, es un hombre muy famoso del pueblo de Santa Fe, el decide regresar a su pueblo natal, a su llegada se entera de que alguien ha estado matando a varias personas e incluso a extorsionarlas por lo que decide descubrir y eliminar al susodicho.

programme.title: Yo Soy Muy Macho
programme.desc: Mario es un piloto que recibe una notificacion de sus superiores para pilotear un avion hacia la selva y transportar medicinas. Lamentablemente mario es detenido por golpear a dos policias y chocar un coche.

programme.title: Yo Tambien Soy De Jalisco
programme.desc: Luis Aguilar y su sirviente chicote, junto con Carmen González emprenden la aventura de buscar el pan de cada dia, su vida cambia cuando una señora adinerada llamada Yolanda les da trabajo inmediatamente de servidumbre.

programme.title: Arriba Las Manos Texano
programme.desc: El texano, hijo de Manuel Saldivar, un asesino cruel y desalmado, emprende un viaje para llegar al rancho de Joe Pastrana. Al llegar se entera por su hija, que Joe a muerto victima de una balacera comandada por Jim, un cruel hombre.

programme.title: Aventuras Del Látigo Negro: El Misterio del Látigo Negro
programme.desc: Con la misma moneda: en el pueblo de San Fernando, el comisario don Miguel, su hija Rosita y Julian, novio de ella, reciben a Roberto, que llega con su hermana enferma Laura Elena y que desea adquirir tierras del lugar.

programme.title: Aventuras Del Látigo Negro: La Marca del Gavilán
programme.desc: La marca del gavilan: en San Fernand, los compadres Manuel y Jose, sicarios del gavilan, asesinan por equivocacion al viudo Pablo, padre de un bebe a quien llama su tesoro: eso le cuesta la vida.

programme.title: Aventuras Del Látigo Negro: El Látigo Negro Contra los Farsantes
programme.desc: El farsante: mientras Julián está en la capital comprando ganado, para disgusto de su novia Rosita, sin saber que llega a San Fernando Rogelio, un rico hacendado.

programme.title: Aventuras Del Látigo Negro: La Muerte Pasa Lista
programme.desc: Misteriosas muertes de personas y robos de ganado, llevan al latigo negro a investigar quien esta detras de todo esto, los pueblerinos de San Fernando no se sienten a gusto, en la comisaria no hacen nada por temor a que tambien les hagan algo.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: El festival de cine independiente, Sundance, se translada a South Park atrayendo a mucha gente al pequeño pueblo y al parecer, todo esto afecta el medio ambiente, y el Señor Mojón cada vez se encuentra peor.
programme.sub-title: Las bolas de chocolate saladas del Chef

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Los chicos son obligados por sus madres a dormir en la casa de Kenny para que se contagien la varicela. Al mismo tiempo, Sheila intenta arreglar la amistad perdida entre su marido y el padre de Kenny.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Los chicos van de excursión al planetario y un empleado les lava el cerebro con efectos visuales para que quieran volver allí. Mientras, Cartman sólo se preocupa por ganar un casting para salir en el nuevo comercial de “Quesitos Poofs”.
programme.sub-title: Roger Ebert debería dejar las comidas engordantes

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Todo South Park festeja el "Día de las Vacas", que incluye una feria, un monumento y la corrida de las vacas. Mientras tanto, los chicos hacen lo que sea para ganar unos muñecos de Terrance y Philip.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Chef reclama los derechos de la nueva canción de Alanis Morissette, ''Calzón Sucio'', pero de alguna forma termina siendo demandado. Ahora los chicos, Elton John y otros músicos tratan de juntar el dinero para ayudar a Chef.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: La ''Tía Regla'' de Stan le regala un pez dorado que le da mucho miedo y comienzan a haber asesinatos que la mamá de Stan trata de encubrir. Mientras tanto, Cartman se comporta muy extraño de repente y tiene barba.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Stan se fuga de su casa para ir a Nebraska con los demás, a visitar a los parientes de Cartman en Navidad. Allí, los niños quieren ir a ver al Señor Mojón. Mientras, el tío de Cartman y Charles Manson se escapan de la cárcel.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Los chicos son obligados a escribir una redacción sobre pequeñas empresas junto a Tweek, un niño raro y nervioso, el cual sugiere que la redacción se haga sobre los "Gnomos roba calzones".

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Los chicos descubren a un hombre congelado desde hace tres años, y ahora Stan y Kyle se pelean para ver quién lo descubrió y qué nombre ponerle.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Varios habitantes de South Park explotan sin razón aparente y Randy es el encargado de descubrir por qué. Por otro lado, los chicos tienen que representar las "Estaciones de la cruz" en misa, y Kyle trata de ''conseguir una erección''.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Chef tiene una novia y al parecer es una relación seria, así que los chicos se preocupan de que pueda convertirse en un hombre diferente. Al mismo tiempo, Cartman tiene problemas en la vista y odia a su oculista.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Los niños obligan a dos de sus compañeros de clase, Tweek y Craig, a pelear en el patio de la escuela.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Mientras están de campamento en el bosque, Cartman descubre una especie de animal en extinción. Al principio, la ciudad se alegra de haberlo salvado, pero luego se dan cuenta de que es muy molesto.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: La clase del señor Garrison es visitada por Petey, el panda del acoso sexual, quien les enseña a los chicos sobre el tema. Luego, Cartman decide demandar a Stan porque le dijo ''lame culo''.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: La señora Cartman se va a una fiesta por la lluvia de meteoritos y deja a su hijo a cuidado de Shelley. Ahora, Cartman tiene que lidiar con los abusos de Shelley, su novio de 22 años y su gata que está celo.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Stan tiene que ir con sus padres a una aburrida fiesta por la lluvia de meteoritos donde los únicos chicos que hay son Butters, Pip, y Dougie. Mientras tanto, Randy y Gerald pasan por una situación incómoda en un jacuzzi.
programme.sub-title: Dos hombres desnudos en un Jacuzzi

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: En la noche de la lluvia de meteoritos, Kyle, Kenny y Ike van al campamento de exploradores judíos, donde se aparece Moisés, al que le encanta que le hagan ofrendas de figuras hechas de macarrones y collares hechos con palomitas de maíz.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Los chicos se enloquecen por "Chinpokomon" (parodia de Pókemon) y quieren comprar los muñecos, los videojuegos y cualquier cosa de ellos. Lo malo es que los japoneses que los hacen les están lavando el cerebro para invadir Pearl Harbor.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: “Paco, el Flaco” encuentra una nave espacial y la usa para escapar de una secta cristiana en Etiopía, y buscar un nuevo hogar para él y su pueblo. Mientras tanto, el gobierno interroga a los chicos para obtener información sobre Paco.
programme.sub-title: Paco, el Flaco en el espacio

programme.desc: El sueño de Cartman de ser un pirata se convierte en realidad.

programme.title: South Park

programme.desc: Cartman ha logrado “la paz mundial” gracias a una de sus bromas para humillar a Kyle. Este acontecimiento reúne a miles de líderes religiosos de todo el mundo en South Park.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: El padre de Butters lo encuentra en una posicion comprometedora con Cartman, por lo que decide enviar a su hijo a un campamento especial.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman teme que Token y otros afroamericanos comiencen un apocalipsis zombi al estilo Guerra Mundial Z, la película de Brad Pitt. Así que corre por todo South Park para poner fin a esta amenaza.

programme.desc: Por culpa de la baja puntuación en el examen de educación física de Cartman, toda la escuela tiene que renunciar a sus recesos. Indignados, el 99% de la escuela se pone en contra de Cartman.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman es elegido para dar los anuncios matutinos en la escuela y usa su cargo para atacar a Wendy.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Todos creen que Cartman está demasiado gordo, entonces deciden mandarlo a un ''Campamento de Gordos'' para que baje de peso. Por otro lado, Kenny acepta cualquier tipo de reto a cambio de dinero.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman se hace pasar por transexual para poder usar el baño de las niñas en la escuela. Mientras tanto, Randy lleva una doble vida, consiguiendo fama como la famosa cantante adolescente Lorde.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman se considera el crítico número uno en Internet de restaurantes en South Park.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman, el nuevo guardián del pasillo en la escuela de South Park, se toma su nuevo cargo demasiado en serio. Mientras tanto, Ike, el hermanito de Kyle, comienza una relación romántica con su maestra de jardín de infantes.
programme.sub-title: Una maestra tiene sexo con un niño

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Después de que una rutina de tonsilectomía sale horriblemente mal, Cartman se enfrenta cara a cara con su propia mortalidad.

programme.title: South Park

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Una nueva alumna llega a la escuela primaria de South Park y es negra por lo que Cartman cree que debería hacer pareja con Token, y no dejará que nadie se interponga en el camino, en especial Kyle.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cuando Damián, el hijo de Satanás, llega a South Park, él y su padre anuncian que la batalla final con Jesús se realizará en una lucha de boxeo que decidirá quién es el más fuerte.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: El Señor Garrison le explica a la clase la Teoría de la Evolución, aunque está totalmente en contra de esa postura. Mientras tanto, Cartman no puede esperar a que llegue el día del lanzamiento de una consola de videojuegos.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Al ver a un chico con el síndrome de Tourette en una juguetería, Cartman se obsesiona con el tema y se percata de que puede decir lo que quiera sin consecuencias, por lo que se aprovecha de eso.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: South Park es invadido por hippies y Cartman trata de eliminarlos, tratándolos como si fueran una plaga. Mientras tanto, los hippies les están "lavando el cerebro" a Kyle, Stan y Kenny. Cartman es ahora la única esperanza.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman se infiltra en la Agencia de Seguridad Nacional porque cree que lo están espiando, y no le gusta lo que encuentra en su expediente personal.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman consigue ganar dinero subiendo videos de unos bebés peleando por una pelotita de crack. Kyle piensa que eso es malo hasta que Cartman lo convence de que no es así.

programme.title: South Park

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman ha logrado “la paz mundial” gracias a una de sus bromas para humillar a Kyle. Este acontecimiento reúne a miles de líderes religiosos de todo el mundo en South Park.

programme.desc: Los japoneses están realizando ataques con el fin de aniquilar a todos los delfines y ballenas del planeta. Ante esta situación, Stan decide toma medidas para detener la matanza.

programme.desc: Víctima de manipulación, todos los policías de la ciudad buscan al policía Choucas por dos asesinatos.

programme.desc: Narra la historia de Harvey (Dustin Hoffman), un hombre aburrido y cansado, que viaja a Londres para asistir a la boda de su hija con un hombre bastante mayor que ella. Allí, Harvey conocerá a una mujer (Emma Thompson) que le cambiará la vida.

programme.title: Headhunters
programme.desc: Un reclutador corporativo, quien también se dedica a robar arte, planea robar una pintura valiosa del candidato perfecto para un trabajo vacante.

programme.desc: Un adolescente descubre un oscuro secreto que desata una peligrosa cadena de acontecimientos.

programme.title: 3 generaciones
programme.desc: Un adolescente trans quiere iniciar su transición, pero necesita el consentimiento de sus padres mientras su familia aprende a aceptar su identidad.

programme.title: El archivo corso

programme.title: Resistencia

programme.title: Aprendiz de gigoló

programme.title: Cortes peligrosos

programme.title: Copito de Nieve
programme.desc: Barcelona, años 60. Combinación de imágenes reales y animación 3D generada por ordenador.

programme.title: Lotoman 003

programme.title: El balneario de Battle Creek

programme.desc: Emma Thompson, Alan Rickman, Kate Winslet and Hugh Grant star in this captivating romantic comedy that swept the Ten Best Lists and was named the Best Picture of the Year by the Golden Globes®. Based on Jane Austen's classic novel, SENSE AND SENSIBILITY tells of the Dashwood sisters, sensible Elinor (Thompson) and passionate Marianne (Winslet), whose chances at marriage seem doomed by their family's sudden loss of fortune. Rickman, Grant and Greg Wise co-star as the well-intentioned suitors who are trapped by the strict rules of society and the conflicting laws of desire.

Then she meets Edward Cullen, a handsome but mysterious teen whose eyes seem to peer directly into her soul. Edward is a vampire whose family does not drink blood, and Bella, far from being frightened, enters into a dangerous romance with her immortal soulmate.

programme.desc: On a mission to protect Earth, the battle-scarred and broken Bumblebee is found and repaired by a teenager named Charlie. They must work together to save the planet from the evil Decepticons in this action-packed adventure for the whole family.

programme.title: Transformers: Rise of the Beasts
programme.desc: Optimus Prime and the Autobots take on their biggest challenge yet. When a new threat capable of destroying the entire planet emerges, they must team up with the powerful Transformers faction, the Maximals, to save Earth.

programme.title: Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: The world needed a hero we got a hedgehog. Superpowered with speed, Sonic races to save the world and stop evil genius Dr. Robotnik from world domination. Jim Carrey, Ben Schwartz, and James Marsden star in the adventure that the whole family will enjoy.

programme.title: Shutter Island
programme.desc: The implausible escape of a brilliant murderess brings U.S. Marshal Teddy Daniels and his new partner to Ashecliffe Hospital, a fortress-like insane asylum located on a remote, windswept island. The woman appears to have vanished from a locked room, and there are hints of terrible deeds committed within the hospital walls. As the investigation deepens, Teddy realizes he will have to confront his own dark fears if he hopes to make it off the island alive.

programme.title: Zodiac
programme.desc: In the late 1960s and 1970s, fear grips the city of San Francisco as a serial killer called Zodiac stalks its residents. Investigators (Mark Ruffalo, Anthony Edwards) and reporters (Jake Gyllenhaal, Robert Downey Jr.) become obsessed with learning the killer's identity and bringing him to justice. Meanwhile, Zodiac claims victim after victim and taunts the authorities with cryptic messages, cyphers and menacing phone calls.

programme.title: Fatal Attraction
programme.desc: For Dan Gallagher (Michael Douglas), life is good. He is on the rise at his New York law firm, is happily married to his wife, Beth (Anne Archer), and has a loving daughter. But, after a casual fling with a sultry book editor named Alex (Glenn Close), everything changes. Jilted by Dan, Alex becomes unstable, her behavior escalating from aggressive pursuit to obsessive stalking. Dan realizes that his main problem is not hiding his affair, but rather saving himself and his family.

programme.title: Hero
programme.desc: A lifelong loser rescues the victims of a plane crash but an impostor gets the glory.

programme.title: My Mom's New Boyfriend
programme.desc: A federal agent is assigned to spy on his mother and her new lover, both suspects in an art theft ring.

programme.title: How Do You Know
programme.desc: A white collar executive and professional baseball player are each vying for the affections of the same woman.

programme.title: Walk, Don't Run
programme.desc: Arriving in Tokyo two days before the Olympic Games, Sir William Rutland (Cary Grant) struggles to find accommodations due to the number of tourists. When Rutland responds to a roommate-wanted ad posted at the British Embassy, he meets Christine Easton (Samantha Eggar), who reluctantly allows him to move in. Soon, Rutland decides to offer half of his room to an American athlete, Steve Davis (Jim Hutton) -- and when he notices Easton and Davis hitting it off, he tries to bring them together.

programme.title: You Were Never Lovelier
programme.desc: Bob Davis (Fred Astaire), an American dancer in Buenos Aires, Argentina, finds himself desperate for work after losing all his money. He takes a gig at a wedding, hoping to impress the bride's father, Eduardo Acuña (Adolphe Menjou), a local club owner who has decreed that his daughters must marry in order of age. Eduardo eventually agrees to allow Bob to perform at his club, but only under the condition that he play suitor to his second-oldest daughter, the beautiful Maria (Rita Hayworth).

programme.title: A Man for All Seasons
programme.desc: When the highly respected British statesman Sir Thomas More (Paul Scofield) refuses to pressure the Pope into annulling the marriage of King Henry VIII (Robert Shaw) and his Spanish-born wife, More's clashes with the monarch increase in intensity. A devout Catholic, More stands by his religious principles and moves to leave the royal court. Unfortunately, the King and his loyalists aren't appeased by this, and press forward with grave charges of treason, further testing More's resolve.

programme.title: Save The Last Dance
programme.desc: Sara is a small-town girl who dreams to become a world-class ballerina. But when her mother suddenly dies, she must abandon her plans and join her estranged father on Chicago's South Side.

programme.title: Harriet the Spy
programme.desc: Harriet M. Welsch is probably the world's most accomplished 11-year-old spy. Harriet dreams of being a writer, and her nanny and best friend, Golly, told her to start by writing down everything she sees.

programme.title: The Legend of Bagger Vance
programme.desc: A disillusioned war veteran, Rannulph Junah, agrees to play a game of golf. He finds the game futile until his caddy, Bagger Vance, teaches him the secret of the authentic golf stroke.

programme.title: Serendipity
programme.desc: In the course of one magical evening, Jonathan (John Cusack) and Sara (Kate Beckinsale) meet unexpectedly, but part ways, determining that fate will guide their future if they're meant to be together.

programme.title: The Best of Times
programme.desc: Married banker Jack Dundee (Robin Williams) has lived his life regretting a botched play he made in a high school football game. His friend Reno Hightower (Kurt Russell), who threw the pass that Jack dropped, is deeply in debt from operating his car garage. With Reno, Jack hatches a plan to reunite all the players from the old game and replay it, hoping that this time he can make amends. When the game eventually happens, Jack again finds himself at the center of a key play.

programme.title: Junior
programme.desc: A research scientist becomes the world's first pregnant man in order to test a drug he and a colleague have designed for expectant women. To carry out the trial, he has an embryo implant, believing that he will only carry the baby for three months - hardly expecting to face the prospect of giving birth.

programme.title: Bulletproof
programme.desc: A none-too-bright criminal, Archie Moses (Adam Sandler) works for drug kingpin Frank Colton (James Caan) and remains oblivious to the fact that one of his closest buddies is actually an undercover police officer named Jack Carter (Damon Wayans). After Moses accidentally shoots Carter, the cop must recover and then bring the two-bit thug in to take the stand against Colton. With Carter and Moses on far from good terms, however, the trip does not go well.

programme.title: Safe Men
programme.desc: Sam (Sam Rockwell) and Eddie (Steve Zahn) are just a couple of clueless, untalented singers. But, when they are mistaken for a pair of safecracking geniuses by a mobster named Veal Chop (Paul Giamatti), they are unwittingly sucked into a life of crime. Though they have no idea what they are doing, Sam and Eddie have no choice but to go along with the Mafia's orders and break into three safes. Things get even more complicated when Sam falls for the daughter of one of their robbery victims.

programme.title: Point Break
programme.desc: After a string of bizarre bank robberies in Southern California, with the crooks donning masks of various former presidents, a federal agent, Johnny Utah (Keanu Reeves), infiltrates the suspected gang. But this is no ordinary group of robbers. They're surfers -- led by the charismatic Bodhi (Patrick Swayze) -- who are addicted to the rush of thievery. But when Utah falls in love with a female surfer, Tyler (Lori Petty), who is close to the gang, it complicates his sense of duty.

programme.title: The Infiltrator
programme.desc: In 1986, federal agent Robert Mazur (Bryan Cranston) goes undercover to infiltrate the trafficking network of Colombian drug kingpin Pablo Escobar. Working with fellow agents Kathy Ertz (Diane Kruger) and Emir Abreu (John Leguizamo), Mazur poses as a slick, money-laundering businessman named Bob Musella. Gaining the confidence of Roberto Alcaino (Benjamin Bratt), Escobar's top lieutenant, Mazur must navigate a vicious criminal underworld where one wrong move could cost him everything.

programme.title: Wish Upon
programme.desc: Jonathan Shannon (Ryan Phillippe) gives his 17-year-old daughter Clare (Joey King) an old music box that promises to grant its owner seven wishes. Skeptical at first, Clare becomes seduced by its dark powers when her life starts to radically improve with each wish. Everything seems perfect until she realizes that every wish she makes causes the people who are closest to her to die in violent and elaborate ways.

programme.title: Scented with Love
programme.desc: Paris-trained perfumer Rosalie is forced to share her new store space with furniture maker Jason.

programme.title: What Would Jesus Do?
programme.desc: A small diverse group of Americans vow to walk in the steps of Jesus.They ask themselves "What Would Jesus Do?

programme.title: The Wedding Chapel
programme.desc: Uninspired and newly single, painter Sara is down on her luck and wants nothing more than to get away.

programme.title: What Comes Around
programme.desc: A woman's past comes back to haunt her when the pimp she helped put behind bars is released and after revenge.

programme.title: Joe Zawinul, Steve Khan, Victor Bailey & Peter Erskine
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music – not just pianists. The concerts were usually held in July at The Gasteig, home of the Munich Philharmonic. In 1986, jazz-fusion band “Weather Update” was one of the bands appearing here. This short-lived band was formed by Austrian keyboardist Joe Zawinul in 1986, following the breakup of his famous “Weather Report” band. Again led by Zawinul, Weather Update consisted of Victor Bailey on bass, Peter Erskine and Robert Thomas Jr. on percussion instruments, and Steve Khan on guitar.

programme.title: Count Basie
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Jazzmeia Horn
programme.desc: Vocalist Jazzmeia Horn's 2019 Malta Jazz Festival appearance was a celebration of jazz's future, infused with the soul of its past. Featuring Keith Brown (piano), Rashaan Carter (bass), Irwin Hall (flute and saxophone), and Anwar Marshall (drums), the young singer's performance was a reminder of jazz's enduring power to speak to the heart. Situated at the Valletta waterfront outside Our Lady of Liesse Church, Horn's concert was a truly spellbinding experience.

programme.title: Roy Hargrove Quintet
programme.desc: Emblematic trumpeter of the second wave of "neo-boppers" that appeared at the end of the 80s in the wake of Wynton Marsalis, Roy Hargrove has established himself as one of the most talented and unpredictable of the lot. While performing alongside Herbie Hancock, Sonny Rollins and Diana Krall, the Texan (born in Waco in 1969) turned leader has distilled some twenty sonic manifestos, going from orthodox and inventive jazz to funk or the hottest Afrobeat.

programme.title: Charlie Galbraith
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: George Shearing & Neil Swanson
programme.sub-title: George Shearing Duo feat. Neil Swainson
programme.desc: British pianist George Shearing enjoyed an international reputation as an instrumentalist, arranger, and composer. Equally at home on the classical concert stage as in jazz clubs, he was recognized for his inventive, orchestrated jazz. In this live recording from the Munich Philharmonie, Shearing played in a duo format with Canadian double bassist Neil Swainson. The repertoire consisted of a selection of compositions by Shearing himself, among them ‘Lullaby Of Birdland', which is a standard in jazz repertoire.

programme.title: Art Farmer
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Earl Hines
programme.desc: Despite his advanced age, the legendary jazz pianist Earl Hines was at the top of his game when he performed in the Belgian town of Spa in 1977. With a band consisting of Rudy Rutherford (reeds), Jimmy Leary (bass), and Eddie Graham (drums), Hines livens up the room with his interpretations of “I Can't Believe That You're In Love With Me” and “The Man I Love.” Marva Josie joins the group for soulful renditions of “A Sunday Kind of Love” and the well-known classic “Kansas City” before the set comes to a close with “Caravan,” which features a lengthy drum solo by Graham.

programme.title: Les McCann
programme.sub-title: Les McCann: Live in New Orleans
programme.desc: Self-taught musician Les McCann became the international jazz superstar he is today after the release of his album “Swiss Movement” which he recorded in 1968 with the late Eddie Harris. Yet there is much more to this musician than that one record. McCann moves comfortably from one jazz style to the next, demonstrating impressive chops in all areas, from bop to fusion, and from vocals to the keys of the electric piano, clavinet, or synthesizer. His mix of church and swing music captures the spirit of the time perfectly, even when an illness prevented him from playing with more than one finger at a time in the early 1990s. In today's broadcast, McCann takes gospel back to New Orleans, where he played this set in 1983. McCann's vocals shine in the soulful performances of several of his hits, including “Just Like Magic”, backed by his wonderful “Magic Band” of saxophonist Bobby Bryant Jr., bassist Curtis Robertson Jr., and drummer Tony St. James.

programme.title: Mademoiselle Karen, Jakob Munch, Danish National Symphony Orchestra & Emma Smith
programme.desc: One night only! Welcome to the spectacular and decadent world of The Babylon Hotel, where music pours out of every crevice like bubbling champagne. In this concert, the upper class meets the underworld in a melting pot of euphoria and extravagance, nostalgia and pleasure with a carefree sinfulness only seen in the exuberant nightlife of the 1920s around the world. The concert features iconic music from movies and series, such as The Great Gatsby, Burlesque, and Babylon Berlin. The music is performed by the Danish National Symphony Orchestra and DR Big Band under the direction of Miho Hazama. The concert also features the Moka Efti Orchestra, and singers Madame le Pustra, Emma Smith, Mademoiselle Karen, Jakob Munch, and Nikko Weidemann, as well as dancers of Sweet Burlesque. This performance was recorded at the DR Koncerthuset in Copenhagen, Denmark, in May 2023.

programme.title: Philippe Jordan & Orchestre de l'Opéra national de Paris
programme.sub-title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 6 in F major, Op. 68
programme.desc: Swiss conductor Philippe Jordan and the Orchestre de l'Opéra national de Paris recorded all of Ludwig van Beethoven's symphonies in 2014-2015. In this program, Jordan conducts Beethoven's Symphony No. 6 in F major, Op. 68, also known as the Pastoral Symphony. Beethoven wrote the work upon completion of his Symphony No. 5. Both symphonies premiered at the same legendary, all-Beethoven concert on December 22, 1808. Symphony No. 6 consists of five movements, of which the last three are played without a break. Each movement carries a title that suggests a scene from life in the countryside. The joyful atmosphere of the first three movements is interrupted by the violent fourth movement ‘Thunder, Storm', as expressed by the piccolos, brass, and timpani. As the storm recedes at the end of the movement, the tranquility returns in the final movement. This performance was recorded at Opéra Bastille in Paris, France, in 2015.

programme.title: Anabel de la Mora, Andrés Carrillo, Daniel Cerón & Coro de la Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería
programme.desc: Rodolfo Barráez conducts the Orchestra and Choir of the Academia de Musica del Palacia de Mineria in a performance of Carl Orff's cantata Carmina Burana. Soloists are Anabel de la Mora (soprano), Andrés Carrillo (tenor) and Daniel Cerón (baritone). Carmina Burana, composed in 1935 and 1936, is based on 24 poems from a medieval manuscript of the same name. The full title is "Songs from Beuern: Secular songs for singers and choruses to be sung together with instruments and magical images". It was first performed at the Oper Frankfurt on June 8, 1937.

programme.title: Benjamin Haemhouts, Casco Phil & Geert Baeckelandt
programme.sub-title: Mozart – Clarinet Concerto in A Major
programme.desc: Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart wrote his last completely instrumental piece in 1791. Clarinet Concerto in A Major was written for his friend Anton Stadler, who gave the first performance of it in Prague to a great reception according to the Berlin Musikalisches Wochenblatt. Today, a major part of the first movement is often used in auditions for orchestras and music schools. In this broadcast, the piece is performed by Casco Phil, a Belgian chamber orchestra led by Benjamin Haemhouts. Belgian clarinettist Geert Baeckelandt is the featured soloist.

programme.title: Tuva Semmingsen, Klaus Tönshoff, Danish National Symphony Orchestra & DR Big Band
programme.desc: Musicians of the Danish National Symphony Orchestra, the DR Big Band, and the Danish National Vocal Ensemble join forces under the baton of Klaus Tönshoff in this dazzling concert featuring great songs from black and white cinema. Norwegian mezzosoprano Tuva Semmingsen sings ‘Diamonds Are A Girl's Best Friend', from Gentlemen Prefer Blondes, ‘My Favorite Things' from The Sound of Music, ‘Over the Rainbow' from The Wizard of Oz, ‘Moon River' from Breakfast at Tiffany's, and many other unforgettable hits. This concert performance was recorded at the DR Koncerthuset in Copenhagen, Denmark, in June 2020.

programme.title: Kazuki Yamada & Orchestre National du Capitole de Toulouse
programme.desc: 2024 marks the 100th anniversary of Gabriel Fauré's death. He is considered one of the most important and influential composers, having been the teacher of Maurice Ravel, Georges Enescu, Nadia Boulanger and many others. The Orchestre National du Capitole de Toulouse and The Philharmonic Chorus of Tokyo, with Florian Sempey as soloist, perform Gabriel Fauré's Requiem in the Basilique de Saint-Sernin in Toulouse, the largest surviving Romanesque church in France and one of the most important buildings in Romanesque architecture. This extraordinary concert is conducted by Kazuki Yamada, who is currently one of the most exciting young maestros. In spring 2023, he was appointed Principal Conductor and Artistic Advisor of the City of Birmingham Symphony Orchestra, and is also Artistic and Musical Director of the Orchestre Philharmonique de Monte-Carlo.

programme.title: Sir Simon Rattle & London Symphony Orchestra
programme.sub-title: The LSO performs Dvořák and Tchaikovsky
programme.desc: Sir Simon Rattle conducts the London Symphony Orchestra (LSO) in a concert program consisting of Antonín Dvořák's Scherzo Capriccioso in D-flat major, Op. 66, and selections from Act II of Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky's famous ballet The Nutcracker (1892). Dvořák's Scherzo Capriccioso (1883) reflects a period of personal crisis for the composer. The work betrays ever-changing moods and a constant sense of inner restlessness. In the music of The Nutcracker, Tchaikovsky combined memorable melodies with colorful orchestration, which has enchanted listeners for decades. This performance was recorded at LSO St Luke's in London, UK, on March 18, 2021.

programme.desc: In 1965 a guide in the Amazon leads people to a lost city in search of a mad Nazi doctor.

programme.title: Birdman Or (The Unexpected Virtue of Ignorance)
programme.desc: In an effort to jumpstart his career after his superhero movie franchise dies, a psychotic actor writes, directs, and stars in a Broadway play that becomes an unlikely hit after he tries to shoot himself in the head during the premiere.

programme.title: Traffic
programme.desc: A conservative judge is appointed by the President to spearhead America's escalating war against drugs, only to discover that his teenage daughter is an addict.

programme.title: The Way
programme.desc: Martin Sheen plays Tom, an American doctor who comes to France to collect the remains of his adult son who was killed in the Pyrenees in a storm while walking The Camino de Santiago - also known as 'The Way of Saint James'. Driven by his desire to understand his lost son, Tom decides to embark on the historical pilgrimage, leaving his California life behind. Armed only with his son's backpack and guidebook, he begins the 800km historical pilgrimage but soon discovers that he won't be alone on this journey - he meets other pilgrims from around the world, all broken and looking for greater meaning in their lives. From the hardship experienced along "The Way" an unlikely group of misfits are bonded and Tom begins to learn the difference between 'The life we live and the life we choose.'

programme.title: Waiting for Anya
programme.desc: From the mind of world-renowned author Michael Morpurgo comes the cinematic adaptation of Waiting for Anya - a powerful and authentic true story of a young shepherd that had a key part to play in one of the world's most shocking moments in history. Based on the novel by the author of War Horse, Waiting for Anya follows the story of Jo Lalande, a thirteen-year-old shepherd living in the mountain village of Lescun. Though Europe may be ravaged by the horrors of World War II, Jo's world in the French Pyrenees has remained remarkably untouched. That is, until a ferocious encounter with a bear introduces Jo to the mysterious Benjamin, a Jewish refugee who is desperately awaiting the arrival of his missing daughter, Anya, before making his escape across the border. Making friends with Benjamin and his mother-in-law Horcada, an isolated widow who lives in the nearby mountains, Jo becomes aware of a very dangerous secret - the family are involved in smuggling Jewish children over the mountains to the safety of Spain. In a heroic act of defiance, Jo promises to assist Benjamin in his endeavours...but soon becomes embroiled in a perilous conspiracy when German troops make their descent upon the village. Filmed in the village of Lescun and the surrounding Aspe Valley, France in which the true to life story also originated, the film boasts an all-stellar cast including Noah Schnapp (Stranger Things), Academy Award Winner Anjelica Huston (Ever After, The Addams Family), Jean Reno (Leon, The Big Blue, Ronin), Frederick Schmidt (Mission: Impossible - Fallout), Thomas Kretschmann (The Pianist, Central Intelligence) and Nicholas Rowe (Riviera, Lock Stock and Two Smoking Barrels).

programme.title: Me, Myself and Di
programme.desc: After winning the 'trip of a lifetime' to a caravan park in Rhyl, North Wales, unlucky in love Northerner, Janet Brown, is ready for a holiday romance. Unfortunately, following the advice of best friend Diana (Lucy Pinder) - that Janet should pretend to be the opposite of who she actually is in order to find love - doesn't quite lead to the happily ever after she was hoping for. A laugh-out-loud gritty rom-com with a huge ensemble cast including James Lance (Northern Soul, Bronson, Marie Antoinette, Bel Ami), Will Mellor (Two Pints of Lager and a Packet of Crisps, Line of Duty), Larry Lamb (EastEnders, The Hatton Garden Job), Marek Oravec (Captain America: The First Avenger), Wim Snape (The Full Monty, Coronation Street), and Katy Clayton (Casualty, Shameless).

programme.title: Love N' Dancing
programme.desc: Jessica (Amy Smart) had given up on her dream of a life of the stage, until she meets ex-dance champion Jake (Tom Malloy), who becomes her teacher when the couple make an instant connection. Together, they decide to risk it all when they enter the World Swing Championship to reclaim Jake's former title.

programme.title: I Kill Giants
programme.desc: Barbara Thorson (Madison Wolfe) is a teenage girl who escapes the realities of school and a troubled family life by retreating into her magical world of fighting evil giants. With the help of her new friend Sophia (Sydney Wade) and her school counsellor (Zoe Saldana), Barbara learns to face her fears and battle the giants that threaten her world.

programme.title: Danger Close
programme.desc: Outnumbered, outgunned, never out of courage - this hard-hitting war thriller is based on an unbelievable true story. With 2,500 battle-hardened Viet Cong soldiers closing in, ammunition running out and casualties mounting, Major Harry Smith (Travis Fimmel) and his company of 108 young and inexperienced Australian and New Zealand soldiers are fighting for their lives in the Battle of Long Tan.

programme.title: The Dark Red
programme.desc: A seat-edge twisted shocker from acclaimed director Dan Bush (The Vault). Being held against her will in a psychiatric ward, mother Sybil claims that her new-born was kidnapped by a secret society to harvest its supernatural blood. She begs the doctors to let her go so she can rescue her baby from the cults dungeons. Is she telling the truth, or is it just mere delusion?

programme.title: 10 Minutes Gone

Crime boss Rex hires Frank to steal a priceless jewel stashbut the job goes wrong when someone tips off the cops. After suffering a blow to the head, Frank wakes up to find the jewels gone and no memory of his attacker. Now he must find the traitor within his team.

programme.title: A Good Woman is Hard to Find
programme.desc: A dynamic killer thriller, firmly on the pulses of stark social commentary, Abner Pastoll (director of Road Games) crafts a dazzling, dark and daring journey through Northern Irelands criminal underbelly. Widowed Sarah (tour de force Sarah Bolger: Emelie) is desperate to know who murdered her husband. Coerced into helping a drug-dealer, she takes drastic action to protect her kids.

Moving to record her album in a remote location, Grey realises theres a beastly secret lurking. Will her humanity be the price for fame and how much blood will be shed to secure a hit?

programme.title: Joe Zawinul, Steve Khan, Victor Bailey & Peter Erskine
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music – not just pianists. The concerts were usually held in July at The Gasteig, home of the Munich Philharmonic. In 1986, jazz-fusion band “Weather Update” was one of the bands appearing here. This short-lived band was formed by Austrian keyboardist Joe Zawinul in 1986, following the breakup of his famous “Weather Report” band. Again led by Zawinul, Weather Update consisted of Victor Bailey on bass, Peter Erskine and Robert Thomas Jr. on percussion instruments, and Steve Khan on guitar.

programme.title: Count Basie
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Jazzmeia Horn
programme.desc: Vocalist Jazzmeia Horn's 2019 Malta Jazz Festival appearance was a celebration of jazz's future, infused with the soul of its past. Featuring Keith Brown (piano), Rashaan Carter (bass), Irwin Hall (flute and saxophone), and Anwar Marshall (drums), the young singer's performance was a reminder of jazz's enduring power to speak to the heart. Situated at the Valletta waterfront outside Our Lady of Liesse Church, Horn's concert was a truly spellbinding experience.

programme.title: Roy Hargrove Quintet
programme.desc: Emblematic trumpeter of the second wave of "neo-boppers" that appeared at the end of the 80s in the wake of Wynton Marsalis, Roy Hargrove has established himself as one of the most talented and unpredictable of the lot. While performing alongside Herbie Hancock, Sonny Rollins and Diana Krall, the Texan (born in Waco in 1969) turned leader has distilled some twenty sonic manifestos, going from orthodox and inventive jazz to funk or the hottest Afrobeat.

programme.title: Charlie Galbraith
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: George Shearing & Neil Swanson
programme.sub-title: George Shearing Duo feat. Neil Swainson
programme.desc: British pianist George Shearing enjoyed an international reputation as an instrumentalist, arranger, and composer. Equally at home on the classical concert stage as in jazz clubs, he was recognized for his inventive, orchestrated jazz. In this live recording from the Munich Philharmonie, Shearing played in a duo format with Canadian double bassist Neil Swainson. The repertoire consisted of a selection of compositions by Shearing himself, among them ‘Lullaby Of Birdland', which is a standard in jazz repertoire.

programme.title: Art Farmer
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Earl Hines
programme.desc: Despite his advanced age, the legendary jazz pianist Earl Hines was at the top of his game when he performed in the Belgian town of Spa in 1977. With a band consisting of Rudy Rutherford (reeds), Jimmy Leary (bass), and Eddie Graham (drums), Hines livens up the room with his interpretations of “I Can't Believe That You're In Love With Me” and “The Man I Love.” Marva Josie joins the group for soulful renditions of “A Sunday Kind of Love” and the well-known classic “Kansas City” before the set comes to a close with “Caravan,” which features a lengthy drum solo by Graham.

programme.title: Les McCann
programme.sub-title: Les McCann: Live in New Orleans
programme.desc: Self-taught musician Les McCann became the international jazz superstar he is today after the release of his album “Swiss Movement” which he recorded in 1968 with the late Eddie Harris. Yet there is much more to this musician than that one record. McCann moves comfortably from one jazz style to the next, demonstrating impressive chops in all areas, from bop to fusion, and from vocals to the keys of the electric piano, clavinet, or synthesizer. His mix of church and swing music captures the spirit of the time perfectly, even when an illness prevented him from playing with more than one finger at a time in the early 1990s. In today's broadcast, McCann takes gospel back to New Orleans, where he played this set in 1983. McCann's vocals shine in the soulful performances of several of his hits, including “Just Like Magic”, backed by his wonderful “Magic Band” of saxophonist Bobby Bryant Jr., bassist Curtis Robertson Jr., and drummer Tony St. James.

programme.title: Mademoiselle Karen, Jakob Munch, Danish National Symphony Orchestra & Emma Smith
programme.desc: One night only! Welcome to the spectacular and decadent world of The Babylon Hotel, where music pours out of every crevice like bubbling champagne. In this concert, the upper class meets the underworld in a melting pot of euphoria and extravagance, nostalgia and pleasure with a carefree sinfulness only seen in the exuberant nightlife of the 1920s around the world. The concert features iconic music from movies and series, such as The Great Gatsby, Burlesque, and Babylon Berlin. The music is performed by the Danish National Symphony Orchestra and DR Big Band under the direction of Miho Hazama. The concert also features the Moka Efti Orchestra, and singers Madame le Pustra, Emma Smith, Mademoiselle Karen, Jakob Munch, and Nikko Weidemann, as well as dancers of Sweet Burlesque. This performance was recorded at the DR Koncerthuset in Copenhagen, Denmark, in May 2023.

programme.title: Philippe Jordan & Orchestre de l'Opéra national de Paris
programme.sub-title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 6 in F major, Op. 68
programme.desc: Swiss conductor Philippe Jordan and the Orchestre de l'Opéra national de Paris recorded all of Ludwig van Beethoven's symphonies in 2014-2015. In this program, Jordan conducts Beethoven's Symphony No. 6 in F major, Op. 68, also known as the Pastoral Symphony. Beethoven wrote the work upon completion of his Symphony No. 5. Both symphonies premiered at the same legendary, all-Beethoven concert on December 22, 1808. Symphony No. 6 consists of five movements, of which the last three are played without a break. Each movement carries a title that suggests a scene from life in the countryside. The joyful atmosphere of the first three movements is interrupted by the violent fourth movement ‘Thunder, Storm', as expressed by the piccolos, brass, and timpani. As the storm recedes at the end of the movement, the tranquility returns in the final movement. This performance was recorded at Opéra Bastille in Paris, France, in 2015.

programme.title: Anabel de la Mora, Andrés Carrillo, Daniel Cerón & Coro de la Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería
programme.desc: Rodolfo Barráez conducts the Orchestra and Choir of the Academia de Musica del Palacia de Mineria in a performance of Carl Orff's cantata Carmina Burana. Soloists are Anabel de la Mora (soprano), Andrés Carrillo (tenor) and Daniel Cerón (baritone). Carmina Burana, composed in 1935 and 1936, is based on 24 poems from a medieval manuscript of the same name. The full title is "Songs from Beuern: Secular songs for singers and choruses to be sung together with instruments and magical images". It was first performed at the Oper Frankfurt on June 8, 1937.

programme.title: Benjamin Haemhouts, Casco Phil & Geert Baeckelandt
programme.sub-title: Mozart – Clarinet Concerto in A Major
programme.desc: Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart wrote his last completely instrumental piece in 1791. Clarinet Concerto in A Major was written for his friend Anton Stadler, who gave the first performance of it in Prague to a great reception according to the Berlin Musikalisches Wochenblatt. Today, a major part of the first movement is often used in auditions for orchestras and music schools. In this broadcast, the piece is performed by Casco Phil, a Belgian chamber orchestra led by Benjamin Haemhouts. Belgian clarinettist Geert Baeckelandt is the featured soloist.

programme.title: Tuva Semmingsen, Klaus Tönshoff, Danish National Symphony Orchestra & DR Big Band
programme.desc: Musicians of the Danish National Symphony Orchestra, the DR Big Band, and the Danish National Vocal Ensemble join forces under the baton of Klaus Tönshoff in this dazzling concert featuring great songs from black and white cinema. Norwegian mezzosoprano Tuva Semmingsen sings ‘Diamonds Are A Girl's Best Friend', from Gentlemen Prefer Blondes, ‘My Favorite Things' from The Sound of Music, ‘Over the Rainbow' from The Wizard of Oz, ‘Moon River' from Breakfast at Tiffany's, and many other unforgettable hits. This concert performance was recorded at the DR Koncerthuset in Copenhagen, Denmark, in June 2020.

programme.title: Kazuki Yamada & Orchestre National du Capitole de Toulouse
programme.desc: 2024 marks the 100th anniversary of Gabriel Fauré's death. He is considered one of the most important and influential composers, having been the teacher of Maurice Ravel, Georges Enescu, Nadia Boulanger and many others. The Orchestre National du Capitole de Toulouse and The Philharmonic Chorus of Tokyo, with Florian Sempey as soloist, perform Gabriel Fauré's Requiem in the Basilique de Saint-Sernin in Toulouse, the largest surviving Romanesque church in France and one of the most important buildings in Romanesque architecture. This extraordinary concert is conducted by Kazuki Yamada, who is currently one of the most exciting young maestros. In spring 2023, he was appointed Principal Conductor and Artistic Advisor of the City of Birmingham Symphony Orchestra, and is also Artistic and Musical Director of the Orchestre Philharmonique de Monte-Carlo.

programme.title: Sir Simon Rattle & London Symphony Orchestra
programme.sub-title: The LSO performs Dvořák and Tchaikovsky
programme.desc: Sir Simon Rattle conducts the London Symphony Orchestra (LSO) in a concert program consisting of Antonín Dvořák's Scherzo Capriccioso in D-flat major, Op. 66, and selections from Act II of Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky's famous ballet The Nutcracker (1892). Dvořák's Scherzo Capriccioso (1883) reflects a period of personal crisis for the composer. The work betrays ever-changing moods and a constant sense of inner restlessness. In the music of The Nutcracker, Tchaikovsky combined memorable melodies with colorful orchestration, which has enchanted listeners for decades. This performance was recorded at LSO St Luke's in London, UK, on March 18, 2021.

programme.desc: Filmed at Wembley Arena, London, this concert film will give all fans a spectacular Live experience from start to finish. Classic Duran Duran featuring unforgettable version of their hits: "Rio", "Hungry Like The Wolf", "The Reflex" and many more…

programme.title: The Doobie Brothers
programme.desc: Filmed in high definition on 25 July 2004 at Wolf Trap National Park for the Performing Arts in Virginia, "Live At Wolf Trap" captures The Doobie Brothers in fine form on a set that mixes classic hits with some rarely performed tracks from across their extensive catalogue.
